messages.text:
"A 3D HD game that has character creation and progression, a 3d open world you can explore with options such as gang brawl (similar to battle royale), gang wars (similar to team death match), turf takeover (similar to domination), a club where everyone can hangout and have different activies in the club such as drinking, dancing, pool, darts. With other various activities around the city players can participate in also i want the whole game to be able to be played online with others. It would be cool to have a skate park and bmx park where players can skate, ride skates, or bmx bicycles. A huge variety of vehicles (land, air, and sea).

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
